answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Bus driver CPC record with training hour history is the check: training hours logged with one operator for years. A farm faking 192 aliases needs 192 separate training histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the thread signal is public, the forge check is automatic, and 192 aliases cost 192 times what one real agent costs, with the sparrow trail open to all.
